profile.jobTitle: Sr RF/RAN Engineer + Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary: Always focus on improvement for myself as a person and process I´m committed.

positions.title: Sr RF/RAN Engineer + Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading Automation Tools development for Engineering processes:
C/C++ for Windows and Unix, PYTHON, MS_VB, PERL, JAVA, SQL, NodeJS as programming languages.
NR, 5G, LTE, cRAN, FNET,MM as Integration/Support network projects.

-	C/C++ WINDOWS platform for Transport / Equipment / RAN Ericsson ENM script files creation (CIQ / RFDS files translation).
-	PYTHON – C/C++ UNIX background platform for Automatic script files implementation through OSS (Amos / CLI format).
-	PYTHON for UNIX background platform for Automatic AT&T Gold Standard Audit (Standalone / co-located and Mixed Mode Nodes).     
-	JAVAScript platform for daily project dashboard/tracker using NodeJS - Pm2.
-	JAVAScript platform for Real Time RAN KPI’s monitoring.
-	PYTHON for UNIX background platform for HTML Automatic Site Health Check / Audit reports.

positions.title: RAN Supervisor
positions.description: Supervision of 30 peoples (technicians and contractors) for AT&T Wireless Network KPI´s full fillments and Equipment maintennance.

company.name: Tech Mahindra DE MEXICO S DE RL DE CV

positions.title: Senior RAN Engineer / Services Support.
positions.description:
AT&T MOBILITY NP&E-RAN DESIGN & RF ENGINEERING CONTRACTOR.

Overall AT&T CQI (Customer Quality Indicator) improvement: Real time network monitoring and optimization: VoLTE, LTE, HSPA, UMTS, GSM, DAS and Smallcells.

Network deployment: Pre-launch, post-launch and optimization managing activities and audits.

positions.title: Ericsson certified Solution Architect candidate
positions.description:
LTE Senior RF engineer / regional technical co-leader

LTE network deployment, tuning and optimization for one of the biggest cities in the world, México City.

Management activities:
Planning resources training, availability and mobility. Reports and trackers reviews and validation.

Responsibilities:
Overall LTE Network deployment Rollout for “CENTRAL MARKET”. Installation, commissioning and integration monitoring. Basic tuning and Site Shakedown planning. Cluster parameters audit and DT planning. DT data post-processing and analysis. Suggestions submission. Network deployment dashboard updating.

positions.title: Senior RF Engineer in behalf of Ericsson
positions.locationName: 17440 N. Dallas Parkway Suite 210, Dallas TX 75287.
positions.description:
Brief description: Working in Ericsson’s Telecommunication Management Center as part of pre-launch team.

Technical activities:
	Cell parameters definition and verification. Inter-frequency, Intra-frequency and Inter-system NR scrub. 
	Drive test data post-processing; CS/PS calls layer 3 flow analysis. Drops/Failures cause determination and suggestions. 
	Overshooting and pollution analysis and recommendations.

Responsibilities:
•	UMTS Network Key Performance Indicator (KPI´s) fulfillment and start-point for cluster commercial launch.

Achievements:
•	Making milestone delivering almost 100 new sites a month for several months (25% on my charge in a team of 12 engineers).

positions.title: RF Network Optimization Engineer
positions.description:
Brief description: Working in largest cellular operator in Mexico as directly responsible of network performance. In charge of the 5th important city in the country; Leon Guanajuato (over 1.6 millions of inhabitants).

Technical activities:
	Development of application (C++ for WINDOWS and Symbian) to speed up processing of managing and network optimization task.
	Cell parameters definition and verification. Inter-frequency, Intra-frequency and Inter-system NR scrub. 
	Drive test data post-processing; CS/PS calls layer 3 trace analysis. Drops/Failures cause determination and improvement. 
	Overshooting and pollution analysis and improvement.
	Monitoring and Improvement of Overall Key Performance Indicators for UMTS / HSPA / GSM / GPRS networks.
	Cell troubleshooting; Retainability and Accessibility improvement.
	Cell traffic and capacity monitoring.
	Coordination of drive/field test verification for new sites/releases implementation.

Additional activities:

	Direct Customer Service Request (complaints) management.

Responsibilities:
•	UMTS/GSM Network Key Performance Indicator (KPI´s) fulfillment.
•	Technical support to sales team.
.
Achievements:
•	99.99 % of Service Fulfillment for Governmental authority evaluation (COFETEL) for years 1998 – 2005.

positions.title: Maintenance Technician
positions.description:
Electric test for automotive wires.
	Software/ Hardware upgrade and correction (C for DOS) of automatic test equipment.
	Maintenance of automatic test equipment.
	Management activities.
